notes.title: Nocturne is part of TGAGWCAGA 2024!
notes.notes:
Nocturne will be featured in TGAGWCAGA 2024—The Game Awards for Games Who Can't Afford the Game Awards! 

This is a grassroots indie community livestream coming this Friday, December 13th!
TGAGWCAGA highlights incredible indie games that truly deserve more attention while also poking a little fun at the exclusivity of The Game Awards.

Subscribe now to TGAGWCAGA’s YouTube channel so you don’t miss out!

📅 TGAGWCAGA 2024
🕔 Friday, December 13th
5:00 PM UTC / 6:00 PM CET / 12:00 PM ET
📺 Watch the stream here: https://www.youtube.com/@TGAGWCAGA

We’ll also be part of the TGAGWCAGA Steam Event running from December 13th to December 22nd, featuring tons of amazing indie games—including ours!

Make sure to join us this Friday, tell your friends and wishlist your favourite titles!

notes.title: Demo Softlock Patch
notes.notes:
If you found yourself unable to progress past the New Game screen, or had a softlock during any of our Tutorials, we've just released a small demo patch to fix those issues. 

[list]
[*] The Satoru fight will no longer softlock even under the most laggy conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue where some OS languages (such as Turkish) wouldn't allow you to create a new game.
[*] Being defeated by Kimothy and Satoru no longer breaks some SFX.
[/list]

You can always find the latest updates to the demo build [url=https://pracystudios.com/changelog]on our website[/url].


If you have any bugs you'd like to report, click the "Bugs & Feedback" button in game.
Or let us know [url=https://discord.pracystudios.com]on discord[/url].

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
After many years of development, we've released our first public Demo.
The demo features the first chapter of the game, which is about 90 minutes of gameplay!

We'd love to see any gameplay videos or livestreams of the Demo, so be sure to link them on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/uDV5Kpk]Community Discord[/url]


But that's not all! We also published our first official Trailer for Nocturne, with some exciting previews of the content to come later in the game.

[previewyoutube=eBykNr15CwQ;full][/previewyoutube]
And lastly: you can now leave reviews for Demos!
This is a great way to let other players know what you thought of Nocturne's Demo.
You can also report any bugs you find using our in-game menu option: "Bugs & Feedback".

Hope you enjoy the Demo!
